name: Incidente em Varginha Remastered
storyline: You play as an ordinary civilian who witnesses the emergency landing of an extraterrestrial spacecraft. From that moment on, you become the target of U.S. military agents determined to seize the craft and cover up the incident at any cost. Early in the story, you encounter one of the surviving alien crew members who, through an advanced communication device, assigns you the mission of recovering the captured ship. To accomplish this, you will travel through several well-known locations across Brazil, following clues that reveal the whereabouts of the alien technology.
summary: First-person action adventure inspired by the Varginha incident. Explore real-world locations, manage resources, use stealth when needed, and recover an alien spacecraft seized by military forces.
